pages.text: Brews potions from samples. Pick a $(bold)potion template$() at the top.$(br2)Ingredients: $(bold)sample with purity ≥25$() + Life Essence Solids + life energy (cost depends on template). The potion inherits the sample's source creature and purity.

$(bold)Permanent potions$() grant stable effects with no side effects. $(bold)Breakthrough potions$() multiply effects ×1.5 but amplify flaws and cause rejection-like side effects.$(br2)Side-effect strength scales with purity - $(2)low-purity samples hit harder$(). Effects differ per creature; collect many samples to find the best recipes.
